headline: certify/20v (cover20 walk, then certify/16e at bound 20) is sound but not certified. The coverage-first method COV_X decided 0/12 fresh 20-state worlds [0.00, 0.24], the same as plain certify/16e (0/12). Only one arm decided anything: COV_O, an oracle walk that reads the true machine and is not deployable, decided 1/12 (12410008, ID) although it reached full reachable coverage on all 12 worlds. The length-matched random control LEN_R decided 0/12; 1 vs 0 is no evidence (McNemar p = 1.00).
